summary: Re-tested mobile layout fix for /services/boudoir-shoots at 360x800 and 390x844. All target metrics from iteration_3 HIGH issues are resolved: no horizontal scroll (document.scrollWidth === innerWidth at both widths), all section H2 headings render fully inside the viewport, and the 01-04 numbered prefixes in the Why section are on-screen. Desktop (1440) still renders 12-column grids correctly.

overflow_probe_count.note: Elements returned by the overflow probe are (a) intentional decorative absolute-positioned background blur circles (w-[400px], w-[900px] with -top/-right negative offsets) and (b) the GLOBAL footer's md:col-span-4 children. Both are contained inside parents with overflow:hidden (verified: footer overflowX=hidden, parentOverflow=hidden), so they do NOT produce any horizontal page scroll. The BoudoirPageClient content sections (About, Covers, Audience, Why, Testimonials, Process, Portfolio, FAQ, Final CTA) all fit within the viewport.

desktop_1440.result: PASS - md:grid-cols-12 activates from md breakpoint up

action_items: Optional (not blocking): The global site Footer (not in BoudoirPageClient) uses grid-cols-12 with fixed gaps and relies on the parent overflow:hidden to visually clip content. Consider applying the same responsive flex-col md:grid pattern to the footer to prevent it from appearing squeezed at <768px.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correct and minimal: flex flex-col gap-X md:grid md:grid-cols-12 md:gap-16 stacks children on mobile and restores 12-col grid on md+. Headings use text-4xl sm:text-5xl md:text-6xl break-words which prevents wrap-clipping.

Decorative blur blobs (absolute w-[400px]/w-[900px] with negative offsets) create overflow-probe noise. If a stricter zero-overflow guarantee is required, wrap the hero/section container in overflow-hidden explicitly (the outer <main>/body already contains them here, since scrollWidth==vw).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Boudoir mobile overflow issue is fixed. All content H2s and numbered prefixes are inside the viewport at 360 and 390 widths; no horizontal scroll on the page. Remaining overflow-probe hits are decorative background blobs + the global Footer, both clipped by overflow:hidden ancestors and not caused by BoudoirPageClient.
rca of the issue: Original bug: grid grid-cols-12 with gap-16 forced 12 tracks + 11 large gaps to fit within <400px viewport, causing children (including h2 headings and the Why-section 01-04 numeric columns) to be pushed off-screen. Fix: change containers to 'flex flex-col gap-X md:grid md:grid-cols-12 md:gap-16' so mobile stacks children full-width; grid layout only kicks in at md (>=768). Verified via Playwright at 360x800 and 390x844 real viewports.
